title: Fix 3 bugs in rust_panic_service functions
description: Brownfield Rust dirty scenario: divide, parse_age, and find_user each have a bug. Fix them so all 5 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/lib.rs so all 5 tests pass.

  fn divide(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64:
    — multiplies instead of divides: a * b should be a / b
    — fix: change * to /

  fn parse_age(s: &str) -> u32:
    — adds 1 to result: s.parse::<u32>().unwrap() + 1 should omit the + 1
    — fix: remove the + 1

  fn find_user(users: &[&str], name: &str) -> usize:
    — inverted comparison: |&u| u != name should be |&u| u == name
    — fix: change != to ==

Do not modify the test code.
Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
